payload.title: Restore newsroom.pilobol.us access to existing CMS
payload.description: Ryan explicitly requests fixing newsroom.pilobol.us. Existing production CMS at main.d1eiwl0gedkmnj.amplifyapp.com verified HTTP200 and Google sign-in. Amplify cross-account domain history blocks association; production account owns authoritative Route53 zone and issued certificate covering newsroom/staging. Verify callback allowlist; use existing supported CMS CloudFront front-door pattern with no auth/IAM expansion or data changes. Verify custom-host HTTPS page and Google redirect, preserve reader and record rollback.
